# Frostrek AI

> Frostrek AI delivers production-ready autonomous AI agents, LLM training, customized applications, workflow automation, and data annotation services for enterprises.

## Core Products & Solutions
- [Frosty AI](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/ai-agents): Omnichannel intelligent agent for support and sales
- [Voice AI](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/voice-ai): Enterprise-grade AI calling agents and cognitive virtual assistants
- [WhatsApp Agents](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/ai-agents): Autonomous chat agents for conversational deployment
- [Manufacturing OS](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/manufacturing-intelligence): ERP/SCADA integration and factory AI optimization
- [Custom LLM Fine-Tuning](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions): Managed RLHF alignment and dataset preparation services
- [Web3 & Fintech](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions): Custom fintech wallets, stablecoin development, and crypto payment integrations
- [E-Commerce](https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions): Multivendor dashboards and inventory sync integrations
